public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply configured timeouts to the version request**

If `/version` accepts a connection but stops responding, this new request can block indefinitely because `session.get()` receives no timeout. Both authentication paths call it before assigning `self._session`, so an optional version probe can now prevent all client operations even when login succeeds. Unlike `RequestHandler.request_with_retry()`, this call ignores `SUPERSET_API_PLUS_TIMEOUT_CONNECT` and `SUPERSET_API_PLUS_TIMEOUT_READ`. Apply those configured timeouts so an unavailable version endpoint cannot hang authentication.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L98-L100](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/58940e5caba6fca8d93974502ac2d0a8271b6501/AGENTS.md#L98-L100)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

causal_evidence: The diff for commit 58940e5caba6fca8d93974502ac2d0a8271b6501 introduces _read_server_version() with session.get() lacking timeout.
The same commit adds synchronous _check_server_version(session) calls to both authentication paths before self._session is assigned; the base lacks these calls.
payload.reviewer_claimed_origin: New version request introduced by the PR.
evidences: supersetapiplus/client.py:150-159: the version request passes verify and headers but no timeout; exception handling cannot interrupt a stalled request.
supersetapiplus/client.py:180-184 and 203-209: both authentication paths await the version probe before assigning self._session.
supersetapiplus/transport/http.py:37-38,143: configured connect/read timeouts are explicitly supplied by RequestHandler, which the probe bypasses.

Offline execution of the exact method extracted from the worktree via AST captured timeout=None at requests.Session.send; no network was used. Full package import was unavailable because shortuuid is missing.
payload.follow_up: Apply the configured connect/read timeouts to the version request and add regression coverage confirming that a version timeout allows authentication to complete.
payload.headline: Version probe can block authentication indefinitely
payload.before: Authentication did not wait for a version probe.
payload.after: Both authentication paths synchronously query /version without a timeout before publishing the session.
payload.motivation: A server that accepts the connection but stops responding can indefinitely block client operations despite successful login.
payload.reply: Confirmed: the new /version request reaches Requests with timeout=None, and both login paths wait for it before assigning self._session. It needs the configured connect/read timeouts so a stalled optional probe cannot block authentication indefinitely.
payload.ca_dod_impact: Violates AGENTS.md:98-100, which requires network timeouts to use SUPERSET_API_PLUS_* configuration.
